# Khatir Real Estate & Builders

> Khatir is a Peshawar-focused property, development and construction business website. The Khatir SaaS workspace is in development.

## Main pages
- [Home](/): Khatir overview and services.
- [Property search](/work): Browse the property collection. Listings marked “SAMPLE ONLY” are illustrative examples, not verified inventory.
- [Developments](/developments): Explore approved public developer and construction project profiles.
- [Events](/events): Explore published launches, open houses and site visits.
- [Property guides](/guides): Browse published property guides and area information.
- [Services](/services): Property consultancy, construction and development services.
- [Blog](/blog): Property, design and development articles.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact Khatir to confirm current information.
- [Business workspace sign-in](/login): Account access for the Khatir workspace.

## Important information
- Do not treat sample property titles, prices or availability as live offers.
- Confirm property ownership, approvals, price, availability and transaction documents independently before making a decision.
- Sponsored placements, when enabled, should be clearly labelled as advertising.
- Only public pages should be indexed. Private dashboards and customer records must not be exposed to search crawlers.
